in_sanskrit.name: दिक्षिता
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has undergone diksha (initiation). A woman who has undergone formal training in Indian classical music, dance or other arts.

in_hindi.name: दिक्षिता
in_hindi.long_meaning: सिखाने वाला (one who teaches or imparts knowledge) या सिखायी (one who has learned).

in_tamil.name: திக்ஷிதா
in_tamil.long_meaning: அழகியவாளர் (one who has undergone initiation or training) என்பது அவர் (the one who has been initiated or trained).

in_telugu.name: దిక్షితా
in_telugu.long_meaning: దీచియేదు (one who has undergone diksha or initiation) యాధోభోజనే (యాధో బోజనే, the one who has learned).

in_marathi.name: Dikshita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dikshita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who studies the sacred scriptures and teachings of dharma.

in_bengali.name: Dikshita
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Student, Learner
in_bengali.long_meaning: Dikshita একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who studies the sacred scriptures and teachings of dharma.
